page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via multithreading. The compute configuration is matched with 256 GB of system RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. CPU instruction support includes AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI for vector math and cryptographic operations. The instance lacks bundled local storage, requiring external network-attached volumes, and delivers a baseline network throughput of 16 Gbps. No discrete GPU acceleration is included.

Benchmark results place the instance in the middle tier for raw CPU performance, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 36,647.59 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 13,842. The memory subsystem exhibits a 153.12 GB/sec throughput for large-block uncached read operations and 68.8 GB/sec for write operations. Under memory-centric testing, the instance achieved 31.33 million Redis SET operations per second. In lightweight machine learning inference benchmarks using vector instructions, text generation on a small 135M parameter model ranked in the upper quartile at 312.77 tokens per second, while larger model execution scaled down proportionally.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.r7t.8xlarge is its high RAM density relative to compute capacity, which prioritizes memory-resident workloads over high compute-bound throughput. Because all storage must be provisioned over the network interface, disk-intensive tasks rely heavily on the 16 Gbps fabric. This profile makes the instance structurally suitable for in-memory caching solutions such as Redis, enterprise relational databases, big data analytics engines, and memory-intensive extract-transform-load (ETL) processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores on a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. Configured with 256 GB of system memory, it offers an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio suited for memory-intensive execution environments. The instance includes a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and supports AVX-512 instruction sets, but includes no local storage or GPU hardware. Benchmark performance indicates balanced compute capabilities, scoring 13,842 on multi-core Geekbench and 36,647.59 on PassMark CPU, alongside a sustained Redis SET throughput of 31.33 million operations per second. With an uncached large-block read memory bandwidth of 153.12 GB/sec, this instance is configured to handle enterprise database management, Redis caching layers, data processing, and large-scale ETL pipelines.
